integrity: Includes a self-contained analytical proof and a supplementary standard-library diagnostic checker. Finite diagnostics are not a proof of infinite-time statements or novelty. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: All-state basin classification proved only for 1<k<e and 0<alpha<min(1,e-k); no claim in other regimes. The complete originating journal article was inaccessible, although a full matching thesis chapter was inspected. The fold 1/n law excludes stationary endpoint states.
title: Exact survival interval and parabolic basin opening in the q-Ricker map
